text: ボールを　ベルトに　セット　１　２　３　４　５　６…　と！

structure.jp: ボールを　ベルトに　セット
structure.en: set the Balls on my belt
one, two, three, four, five, six...

patterns.name: 〜と (finishing an action)
patterns.explanation: A と said on its own at the end of a small job is what people say to themselves as they finish it. ６…　と！ = 'six... and there!'
